import os, sys, unittest, sqlite3
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts
from src.api import handle_import

def row(email, name="N"):
    return {"email": email, "name": name}

class ImportContactsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        initialize(self.c)

    def test_empty_batch(self):
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, []), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_insert_trim_lowercase(self):
        r = import_contacts(self.c, [row("  Alice@Example.COM ", "  Alice  ")])
        self.assertEqual(r, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("alice@example.com", "Alice")])

    def test_existing_counts_as_updated_even_if_same_name(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "a@b", "Alice")
        r = import_contacts(self.c, [row("a@b", "Alice"), row("c@d", "Carol")])
        self.assertEqual(r, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "Alice"), ("c@d", "Carol")])

    def test_update_existing_name(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "a@b", "Old")
        import_contacts(self.c, [row("A@B", "New")])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "New")])

    def test_invalid_rows_rejected(self):
        bad = [
            "a@b",
            None,
            ["a@b", "x"],
            {"email": "a@b"},
            {"email": "a@b", "name": "x", "extra": 1},
            {"email": 1, "name": "x"},
            {"email": "a@b", "name": None},
            {"email": "ab", "name": "x"},
            {"email": "a@b@c", "name": "x"},
            {"email": "@b", "name": "x"},
            {"email": "a@", "name": "x"},
            {"email": "a @b", "name": "x"},
            {"email": "a\tb@c", "name": "x"},
            {"email": "a@b", "name": "   "},
            {"email": "  ", "name": "x"},
        ]
        for r in bad:
            with self.subTest(r=r):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    import_contacts(self.c, [row("ok@x"), r])
                self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_duplicate_normalized_emails_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            import_contacts(self.c, [row("A@b", "1"), row(" a@B ", "2")])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_failure_rolls_back_whole_batch(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "keep@x", "Keep")
        self.c.execute(
            "CREATE TRIGGER boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'z@x' "
            "BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END"
        )
        self.c.commit()
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.DatabaseError):
            import_contacts(self.c, [row("keep@x", "Changed"), row("new@x"), row("z@x")])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("keep@x", "Keep")])

class ApiImportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        initialize(self.c)

    def test_envelope_ok(self):
        r = handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": [row("a@b", "A")]})
        self.assertEqual(r, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})

    def test_malformed_envelopes_rejected(self):
        for p in [None, [], {}, {"rows": []}, {"contacts": None},
                  {"contacts": {}}, {"contacts": [], "extra": 1}]:
            with self.subTest(p=p):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    handle_import(self.c, p)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
